messages.normal: Hive status optimal. Internal environmental parameters within standard screening thresholds.
messages.thermalSpike: Abnormal thermal spike detected (>38.0°C). Beekeeper inspection recommended.
messages.thermalDrop: Colony temperature drop detected (<31.0°C). Check hive insulation and cluster status.
messages.humidityHigh: Elevated moisture condensation detected (>70%). Inspect hive ventilation.
messages.swarmAlert: Acoustic shift to 210Hz indicates potential queen distress / pre-swarm activity.
